operational_rule: Count as primary only when a source reports an extractable method-task-system validation unit within the inferred topic.
included_as_primary_when: Target-system learning/domain-constrained method with quantitative or validation evidence.
classified_as_contextual_when: Review, taxonomy, broad background, benchmark motivation, or generic method without target-system evaluation.
excluded_when: Outside scope or no extractable evidence.

operational_rule: A method is domain-specific when the source embeds power-system, microgrid, converter, topology, or operating-constraint information.
included_as_primary_when: Physics/domain features materially shape learning, control, or evaluation.
classified_as_contextual_when: Generic ML is discussed as background or method transfer.
excluded_when: Generic ML with no power-system or microgrid operational evidence.

classification_problem: Physics-informed or domain-constrained vs ordinary data fitting
operational_rule: Physics-informed/domain-constrained requires explicit equations, topology, certificates, constraints, physical residuals, or device models.
included_as_primary_when: The method uses residuals, graph topology, Lyapunov/barrier functions, power-flow/DAE models, or hard constraints.
classified_as_contextual_when: The source motivates such methods but does not evaluate one.

operational_rule: Runtime enforcement acts in the deployed optimizer/controller; training penalty shapes the learned artifact before deployment.
included_as_primary_when: Constraints appear in MPC, safe policy, explicit controller, projection, or online optimization.
classified_as_contextual_when: Constraint appears only in loss or as diagnostic metric.
excluded_when: No constraint or enforcement mechanism reported.

operational_rule: Operational claims directly consume decisions; enabling claims provide models, predictors, or diagnostics for later decisions.
included_as_primary_when: Controller, scheduler, dispatch, restoration, or protection decision is evaluated.
classified_as_contextual_when: Modeling, forecasting, state estimation, or method-development evidence supports later operation.

operational_rule: Admissibility requires limits, violation magnitude/duration, timing, assumptions, and latency fit; otherwise primary evidence is plausibility.
included_as_primary_when: All admissibility requirements are reported in the claim row.
classified_as_contextual_when: Some but not all operational-admissibility requirements are present.

operational_rule: Assign F0 static/offline, F1 ordinary dynamic simulation, F2 EMT/switching/high-fidelity transient, F3 real-time/HIL/lab/field/prototype.
included_as_primary_when: Use the highest directly reported validation fidelity for the claim.
classified_as_contextual_when: Use NR when validation setting is not reported.
excluded_when: Do not infer fidelity from method name alone.

operational_rule: A0 unclear context/limits; A1 context plus metric; A2 explicit condition plus constraint/stability/feasibility outcome; A3 A2 plus robustness breadth, runtime/latency, and baseline/ablation.
included_as_primary_when: Assign by reported claim fields only.
classified_as_contextual_when: Use lower tier when one requirement is missing.
excluded_when: Use A0 when operational context or limits are unclear.

operational_rule: Source-level eligibility and claim-level evidence are separate denominators.
included_as_primary_when: Study counts use one row per citation_key in studies_cleaned.
classified_as_contextual_when: Claim counts use claims joined to Included studies only.
excluded_when: Never mix contextual/excluded sources into included-claim synthesis.
